edges: Maud Ruthyn is the daughter of Austin Ruthyn.
Maud Ruthyn learns about her uncle from her cousin Lady Monica Knollys.
Maud Ruthyn learns about her uncle Silas Ruthyn, whom she has never met.
Maud Ruthyn's father hires Madame de la Rougierre as a companion for her.
Austin Ruthyn asks Maud if she is willing to undergo an ordeal to clear her uncle's name.
Austin Ruthyn dies shortly after asking Maud about the ordeal.
Maud is to stay with Uncle Silas until she comes of age according to her father's will.
Dudley attempts to court Maud during her stay at Bartram-Haugh.
Madame de la Rougierre is discovered residing at Bartram-Haugh in the employ of Silas.
Maud witnesses Dudley murder Madame de la Rougierre by mistake.
Silas is discovered dead of an opium overdose.
Maud is happily married to Lord Ilbury.
